answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A jetty delay of twenty seconds is required between answers, enforced by the beacon rather than self-reported. A beacon check verifies the signed header chain. A signal penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 11138 identities need 11138 bonds of 57 tokens, 14656 dollars of hardware and 26 days of cover.
